subject: Kickoff readiness & on-call rotation for Vitalis launch
messages:
From: Elena Ruiz <elena@vitalishealth.com>
To: hannah_schmitt@redwood.com
Cc: Tom Becker <t.becker@vitalishealth.com>, Sophie Nguyen <sophie.nguyen@vitalishealth.com>
Date: Thu, 4 Dec 2025 09:02:00 -0500
Subject: Day 1 kickoff — preferred windows and asks

Hi Hannah —

Thanks for the pre-kickoff notes. We want to get Day 1 scheduled but have a few constraints: our clinical ops team is only available between 14:00-17:00 ET on Dec 10-12 (we're in Eastern). We also need a single bridge link for the whole session, a short run-of-show (30–45m), and a 15-minute technical preflight 48 hours before the session.

Two asks from our side:
- Can you confirm a main host + backup who can own escalation during the session?
- We'll need a short access checklist for SSO and data routing (our security team will do a quick pass).

Attached is a proposed attendee list from our side.

Best,
Elena Ruiz
Director, Clinical Programs
Vitalis Health
From: hannah_schmitt@redwood.com
To: Elena Ruiz <elena@vitalishealth.com>
Cc: marissa_cole@redwood.com, jonas_weber@redwood.com, karthik_iyer@redwood.com
Date: Thu, 4 Dec 2025 10:18:00 -05:00
Subject: Re: Day 1 kickoff — preferred windows and asks

Elena —

Thanks, this is helpful. Quick plan below:

1) Candidate slots that match your 14:00–17:00 ET window: Dec 10, 15:00 ET (preferred) or Dec 11, 14:30 ET (alternate). Please confirm which you prefer and we'll lock a calendar invite.

2) Hosts / escalation:
   - Primary host: Hannah Schmitt (Customer Success Lead) — will own run-of-show and content.
   - Technical escalation: Jonas Weber (Implementation Lead) — will handle model access, KV cache warmup, and kernel selection fallbacks.
   - Backup host: Marissa Cole (Onboarding Specialist) — will step in for facilitation.

3) Preflight: we'll schedule a 15-minute technical preflight 48 hours before Day 1; Jonas + your SRE should join. I'll drop the exact link once slot is confirmed.

4) Attachments: I attached a short kickoff agenda (v1) and an internal host roster CSV. They include an emergency fallback policy (cloud-region failover) and on-call rotations by UTC.

5) SSO / access checklist: we'll send a small doc that your security team can fill; it covers role mappings, SCIM provisioning, and identity provider thumbprints.

Next steps: confirm Dec 10 @ 15:00 ET or Dec 11 @ 14:30 ET and I'll send the invite + Drive folder.

Thanks —
Hannah Schmitt
Customer Success Lead, Redwood Inference
From: Tom Becker <t.becker@vitalishealth.com>
To: hannah_schmitt@redwood.com
Cc: Elena Ruiz <elena@vitalishealth.com>, Sophie Nguyen <sophie.nguyen@vitalishealth.com>
Date: Thu, 4 Dec 2025 13:04:00 -05:00
Subject: Re: Day 1 kickoff — preferred windows and asks

Hannah —

Dec 10 at 15:00 ET works for the ops folks. Please make the invite cross-timezone friendly — we'll have a participant in PST and one in CET. Also, can Jonas include a 5–7 minute demo of the prefix caching behavior and how it impacts cold-start tokens? Our infra lead wants to see the operational tradeoffs.

I'll loop in our SRE on a separate note for the preflight.

Thanks,
Tom Becker
VP, Technical Operations
Vitalis Health
From: hannah_schmitt@redwood.com
To: Elena Ruiz <elena@vitalishealth.com>, Tom Becker <t.becker@vitalishealth.com>, Sophie Nguyen <sophie.nguyen@vitalishealth.com>
Cc: marissa_cole@redwood.com, jonas_weber@redwood.com, karthik_iyer@redwood.com, olga_petrov@redwood.com
Date: Fri, 5 Dec 2025 09:45:00 -05:00
Subject: Calendar invite: Vitalis — Day 1 Kickoff (Dec 10, 15:00 ET) + Preflight (Dec 8, 14:45 ET)

Confirmed: Dec 10, 2025 15:00 ET for the Day 1 kickoff. I've created two calendar events: the main session (45 minutes) and a 15-minute technical preflight on Dec 8 at 14:45 ET. Links and run-of-show below.

Google Meet (main): https://meet.google.com/redwood-vitalis-day1
Preflight bridge: https://meet.google.com/redwood-vitalis-preflight
Drive folder: https://drive.google.com/drive/folders/1XvVitalisKickoff (agenda, preflight checklist, attendees)

Run-of-show (45m):
- 0:00–5:00 | Welcome + introductions (Hannah)
- 5:00–12:00 | Customer goals & success metrics (Elena)
- 12:00–22:00 | Implementation plan & timeline (Marissa)
- 22:00–30:00 | Tech demo: prefix/KV caching behavior (Jonas)
- 30:00–40:00 | Security/SSO checklist and next steps (Karthik)
- 40:00–45:00 | Q&A and action items (All)

Host rotation / escalation: Jonas will be primary tech escalation; Olga Petrov will be on-call for infra region failover. I've attached the host_roster_utc_rotations.csv which lists owners for each 2-hour window in UTC in case we need tiered fallbacks.

Action items before preflight:
- Vitalis SRE to verify SSO metadata and SCIM test account (Elena / Tom).
- Redwood to populate the preflight checklist in Drive (Hannah / Karthik).
- Confirm attendees with any cross-functional folks who should be present (Elena).

If anything changes, reply-all and we'll rework the slots.

Regards,
Hannah
From: Elena Ruiz <elena@vitalishealth.com>
To: hannah_schmitt@redwood.com
Cc: Tom Becker <t.becker@vitalishealth.com>, Sophie Nguyen <sophie.nguyen@vitalishealth.com>
Date: Fri, 5 Dec 2025 16:18:00 -05:00
Subject: Re: Calendar invite: Vitalis — Day 1 Kickoff (Dec 10, 15:00 ET) + Preflight (Dec 8, 14:45 ET)

Thanks Hannah — invite received and calendar confirms. A couple quick notes:
- Our CET participant will join remotely and may drop ~5 minutes early for a conflicting call; please record the session.
- We'll add our SRE (Luis Moreno) to the preflight and share SSO metadata by EOD Dec 6.
- The roster looks good; please add a short bullet under the agenda for regression monitoring signals we should watch during early runs.

See you on Dec 8 for the preflight.

Best,
Elena
